description_en: Query the list of APNs supported by 5G Express Cloud Connect
description_zh: 查询5G高速上云服务支持的APN列表
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g list-apns --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --apn CMWAP --isp unicom --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAPNs

parameters.description_en: Region ID of the cloud connector instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only.
parameters.description_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou。
parameters.help_en: Region ID of the cloud connector instance. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only.
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
Used to mark the position from which to start reading. An empty value indicates starting from the beginning.  

> You do not need to specify this parameter in the first invocation. The NextToken for the second invocation will be included in the return result. Each subsequent response will contain the NextToken for the next invocation.
parameters.description_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

> 第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken。
